sections.title: Why the wiki feels like cheating

items.q: What beats dumping everything into raw chat context?
items.a: **Data + routing.** Once transcripts, PDFs, and articles live in **`raw/`** and get ingested into **`wiki/`** with **`index.md` + `log.md`**, agents crawl backlinks instead of burning tokens on blind search. Nate's line: **"Data is king. Context is king."**

items.q: How fast can you bootstrap a Karpathy LLM wiki?
items.a: About a **5-minute setup**: Obsidian vault → open in VS Code → paste Karpathy's gist + screenshot → "You are now my LLM wiki agent" → schema + first ingest. Live demo: PDF + URL → ~**10–12 min** → **~20 cross-linked wiki pages**.

items.q: Should every vault use the same folder layout?
items.a: No. Nate's **YouTube wiki** uses structured subfolders (sources, concepts, entities, tools, techniques); his **meeting wiki** stays **flat** until patterns emerge — flat is easier for agent search at small scale. **`raw/` is immutable; `wiki/` is LLM-owned** (one source may spawn **5–50 pages**).

items.q: How do multiple wikis fit inside one AIOS?
items.a: Topic-separated vaults nest inside **Herk2**; **`CLAUDE.md` acts as a router** so agents land in the right vault without token-wasting search. Obsidian is the **human IDE** — agents read the same markdown; graph view is optional browsing.

sections.title: Fable vs Opus and synthesis payoff

items.q: When should you reach for Fable instead of Opus?
items.a: Same wiki backend: **Fable** one-shotted a beginner-friendly HTML concept map and a branded **6-month business visual journey** from Herk2 data; **Opus** needed a full day and still felt confusing. Fable is overkill for setup; better for **ambitious post-data synthesis**. Opus/Sonnet are fine for ingest.

items.q: What's the killer feature of cross-source wiki synthesis?
items.a: Cross-links surface comparisons you'd miss in separate summaries — e.g. **frontier model cyber security** where OpenAI benchmarked against a **Mythos preview** while Anthropic compared to an **April predecessor**, with **different harnesses** so numbers don't line up.

items.q: Is the wiki locked to Claude Code?
items.a: No — it's **tool-agnostic markdown** with routing rules. Connect Hermes, Codex, or any agent. Batch ingest works if you review folder structure and update **`AGENTS.md`** when organization feels wrong. Free Build Your Own AIOS course lives in **AI Automation Society** Skool.
